summary: In-game reference overlay (L key) with 6 tabs: Game Guide (static tutorial text), Quests (active/completed quest log with baseline-delta progress), Skills (all skills with KNOWN/AVAILABLE flags), Titles (all titles with EARNED flags + acquisition odds), Stats (flattened StatTracker analytics), Inventions (LLM-invented recipes with rich @-line formatting). There is NO discovery/unlock gating — every skill, title, and quest definition is always listed; only status annotations change. State lives in a tiny Encyclopedia class (is_open, current_tab, scroll_offset) on the Character; all layout/rendering is in Renderer; all input routing is in GameEngine. Materials, equipment, and enemies have no encyclopedia entries (no bestiary/item compendium).
player_facing: Press L to toggle the Encyclopedia; opening it auto-closes the other 5 overlay panels (stats/equipment/skills/map/quest log) (game_engine.py:888-897, game_engine.py:7499-7525)
ESC closes it, with ESC priority chain crafting > stats > equipment > skills > encyclopedia > map (game_engine.py:820-835)
Left-click outside the window closes it; left-click inside is consumed; right-click anywhere is suppressed while open (game_engine.py:2557-2565, game_engine.py:1495-1496)
Mouse wheel scrolls content 20 px per notch, only when cursor is inside the window (game_engine.py:1446-1452)

Window: 1000x700 scaled, horizontally centered, y=scale(40), near-opaque dark blue fill (20,20,30,250); gold 'ENCYCLOPEDIA' title + gray hint line '[L or ESC] Close | [Mouse Wheel] Scroll' (renderer.py:3612-3623)

6 clickable tabs in a row: GAME GUIDE, QUESTS, SKILLS, TITLES, STATS, INVENTIONS; active=blue-purple bg, hovered=mid, idle=dark; clicking sets current_tab (renderer.py:3630-3667, game_engine.py:3257-3269)

Guide tab: static hardcoded text — controls (WASD/TAB/click/C/E/K/L/1-5/wheel), progression, crafting (instant vs minigame 1.5x XP), skills (5 hotbar slots, max level 10), titles overview (encyclopedia.py:290-332)

Quests tab: ACTIVE QUESTS with 20x20 icon from quests/{quest_id}.png (fallback '📜 ' emoji prefix), description truncated at 80 chars + '...', per-objective progress with check/circle glyph and green-when-complete color, '✅ Ready to turn in!' line, rewards preview (XP/Gold/Stat Points/Skills/Items); COMPLETED QUESTS greyed 16x16 icon at alpha 128 with green check (renderer.py:4313-4489)

Skills tab: header 'All Skills (N total)', grouped by tier 1-4 with tier-colored '━━ TIER n ━━' headers; each entry = 24x24 icon, name + ' [KNOWN]' (green) / ' [AVAILABLE]' (yellow, learnable now) / plain gray, 'Requires: Lvl X, stat reqs' line, effect summary line (renderer.py:4491-4568)

Titles tab: header 'All Titles (N total)', grouped novice/apprentice/journeyman/expert/master; each entry = 24x24 icon, name + ' [EARNED]' in gold when held, 'Requires: <threshold> <activity>' with '(20%/10%/5%/2% chance)' appended for random_drop tiers, bonus description in green (renderer.py:4570-4668)

Stats tab: 'Player Statistics (N tracked)' header, 'Total Playtime: X.X hours' line, then every numeric StatTracker field flattened, sorted by value descending, grouped under category headers, value-magnitude color banding (renderer.py:4670-4788)

Inventions tab: empty state = how-to-invent instructions; otherwise 'Total Inventions: N', recipes grouped by discipline (smithing, refining, alchemy, engineering, adornments-displayed-as-ENCHANTING), sorted tier then name; each entry shows [Tn] name (Rarity), type path, discipline-specific stats, up to 6 tags, enchant applies-to + effect, up to 4 input materials, up to 3 wrapped lore lines in quotes — each line type color-coded (encyclopedia.py:21-194, renderer.py:4790-4919)
Opening/closing records menu-open events and open-duration to StatTracker analytics (game_engine.py:893-897, game_engine.py:7493-7497)
mechanics: State model: Encyclopedia holds only is_open (bool), current_tab (str, default 'guide'), scroll_offset (int px); constructed per-Character (encyclopedia.py:11-14, character.py:107)
toggle() flips is_open and resets scroll_offset to 0 ONLY when opening; closing and tab-switching do not touch scroll (encyclopedia.py:16-19, game_engine.py:3264-3269)

Unlock model: none. All SkillDatabase skills, all TitleDatabase titles, all quest defs render unconditionally; player state only changes annotation/color: skill 'has' = skill_id in character.skills.known_skills, 'can learn' = can_learn_skill(skill_id, character)[0]; title 'earned' = character.titles.has_title(title_id) (renderer.py:4534-4535, renderer.py:4624)
Tab set is fixed: guide/quests/skills/titles/stats/recipes ('recipes' tab id renders label 'INVENTIONS') (renderer.py:3630-3637); dispatch if/elif per tab (renderer.py:3677-3688)

Scrolling: engine subtracts event.y*20 from scroll_offset, clamps min to 0, no max clamp; renderers cull lines outside content_rect (skip-above / break-below) so overscroll just shows blank (game_engine.py:1450-1452, renderer.py:4288-4291, renderer.py:4524-4531)

Invented-recipes text pipeline: get_invented_recipes_text() groups character.invented_recipes by 'discipline', renders in fixed order [smithing, refining, alchemy, engineering, adornments], unknown disciplines appended last; within group sorted by (station_tier asc, item_name asc) (encyclopedia.py:57-94)

Recipe entry line protocol: header '  [Tn] Name (Rarity)' (rarity suffix omitted when 'common'); then prefixed lines '@type', '@stat', '@tags', '@applies', '@effect', '@recipe', '@lore' — renderer detects startswith and slices line[12:] (fixed 12-char prefix field), substituting display labels (Tags:/Applies to:/Effect:/Materials:) (encyclopedia.py:123-193, renderer.py:4846-4910)

Stats extraction per discipline: smithing reads baseDamage/baseDefense/attackSpeed(!=1.0 shown as 'x')/critChance(*100%)/[fire|ice|lightning|poison]_damage; alchemy reads healing.heal_amount, healing.heal_per_second, mana_restore, buff_duration, damage_boost/defense_boost(*100%); engineering reads baseDamage/range/duration/cooldown/stackSize>1; refining reads statMultipliers hardness/conductivity/weight(!=1.0) + stackSize>1 (encyclopedia.py:196-266)
Enchant effect display: dict effect{type,value}; float value <1 rendered '+int(value*100)%', else '+value' (encyclopedia.py:154-162)
Effect tags: item_data.effectTags, falling back to metadata.tags; filters out ['invented','material','refined']; shows max 6 joined by ', ' (encyclopedia.py:138-145)
Recipe inputs: max 4 shown; materialId (fallback material_id) snake_case -> Title Case via replace('_',' ').title(); qty (fallback quantity) >1 appends ' xN' (encyclopedia.py:165-178)

Lore: metadata.narrative preferred over top-level narrative; word-wrapped at 55 chars via greedy wrap; max 3 lines; opening quote on first line, closing quote on last (encyclopedia.py:180-191, encyclopedia.py:268-288)

Quest gather progress = character.inventory.get_item_count(item_id) - quest.baseline_inventory.get(item_id, 0), complete when >= required (renderer.py:4368-4384); combat progress = character.activities.get_count('combat') - quest.baseline_combat_kills (renderer.py:4392-4399); 'Ready to turn in' from quest.check_completion(character) (renderer.py:4413)

Stats tab flattening: recursive over stat_tracker.to_dict(), skips keys 'version'/'session_start_time', keeps int/float leaves; category = topmost dict key encountered else 'General'; display name = last prefix segment + leaf, Title Cased; sorted by (-value, name) (renderer.py:4685-4712)

Stats value formatting: float >=1000 -> '{:,.1f}', >=100 -> '{:.1f}', else '{:.2f}'; int >=1000 -> '{:,}'; color bands 0=dark gray, <10, <100, <1000, >=1000 progressively brighter (renderer.py:4753-4780)
Guide-tab line styling by content: '===' prefix = gold font +30px, '•' bullet = small font +20px, '' = +10px, endswith ':' = light blue +25px, else tiny font +18px (renderer.py:4288-4311)
Panel exclusivity: _close_other_overlay_panels(keep) closes the other 5 overlays via their own toggles so scroll-reset and menu-time stats fire (game_engine.py:7499-7525)

Render handshake: engine calls renderer.render_encyclopedia_ui(character, mouse_pos) each frame while open; returns (window_rect, tab_rects[(rect, tab_id)]) which engine stores for click/wheel hit-testing; cleared to None/[] when closed (game_engine.py:8781-8787, renderer.py:3690-3693)
Tab clicks tested in window-relative coords (mouse - window origin) because tab rects are built on the panel surface (game_engine.py:3261-3267, renderer.py:3640-3646)
Encyclopedia state is NOT saved/loaded — transient UI (no matches in save_manager.py)
data: character.invented_recipes list records: {discipline: 'smithing', station_tier: 2, item_name: 'Ember Blade', narrative: '...', recipe_inputs: [{materialId: 'iron_ingot', qty: 3}], item_data: {rarity: 'rare', category/type/subtype, effectTags: ['fire','burn'], effectParams: {baseDamage: 50, critChance: 0.05, fire_damage: 8, healing: {heal_amount, heal_per_second}, mana_restore, buff_duration, damage_boost, range, duration, cooldown}, statMultipliers: {attackSpeed, hardness, conductivity, weight}, stackSize, applicableTo (fallback applicable_to), effect: {type, value}, metadata: {narrative, tags}}} (encyclopedia.py:102-266)
SkillDatabase.skills: tier (int 1-4), name, icon_path, requirements.character_level, requirements.stats dict, effect.effect_type/category/magnitude (renderer.py:4510-4563)

TitleDatabase.titles: tier ('novice'..'master'), name, icon_path, activity_type (mining/forestry/smithing/refining/alchemy/enchanting/engineering/combat), acquisition_threshold, acquisition_method ('random_drop' triggers chance suffix), bonus_description (renderer.py:4589-4665)

NPCDatabase.quests + character.quests.active_quests / completed_quests; quest_def: title, description, objectives.objective_type ('gather' with items[{item_id, quantity}] | 'combat' with enemies_killed), rewards.{experience, gold, stat_points, skills[], items[{item_id, quantity}]}; quest instance: baseline_inventory dict, baseline_combat_kills, check_completion() (renderer.py:4316-4443)
MaterialDatabase.get_material(item_id).name for objective/reward item display names (renderer.py:4378-4380, renderer.py:4438-4440)
character.stat_tracker.to_dict() nested numeric analytics incl. total_playtime_seconds (renderer.py:4683, renderer.py:4726)

ImageCache assets: 'quests/{quest_id}.png' (20x20 active, 16x16 completed), skill_def.icon_path and title_def.icon_path at 24x24 (renderer.py:4340-4342, renderer.py:4470-4472, renderer.py:4539-4541, renderer.py:4630-4632)
constants: Scroll speed: event.y * 20 px per wheel notch, min clamp 0, no max clamp (game_engine.py:1450-1452)
Window size: Config.MENU_LARGE_W/H = scale(1000) x scale(700); position x=(VIEWPORT_WIDTH-ww)//2 clamped >=0, y=scale(40) (config.py:147-148, renderer.py:3613-3615)
Panel fill RGBA (20,20,30,250); content area bg (30,30,40) border (80,80,100) width 2 (renderer.py:3618, renderer.py:3673-3674)
Tabs: y=80, width=115, height=40, spacing=8, first x=30 (all scaled) (renderer.py:3626-3641)
Discipline display order: ['smithing','refining','alchemy','engineering','adornments']; 'adornments' header renamed 'ENCHANTING' (encyclopedia.py:66, encyclopedia.py:78-79)
Tag filter blocklist: ['invented','material','refined']; max 6 tags shown (encyclopedia.py:143-145)
Lore wrap width 55 chars, max 3 lines (encyclopedia.py:184-185)
@-prefix slice offset: line[12:] — prefix field is exactly 12 chars ('@stat       ' etc.); formatting contract between encyclopedia.py and renderer (encyclopedia.py:130-191, renderer.py:4866-4908)
Title random_drop chance table (display only): apprentice 20%, journeyman 10%, expert 5%, master 2% (renderer.py:4656)
Title tier order/colors: novice (150,150,150), apprentice (100,200,100), journeyman (100,150,255), expert (200,100,255), master (255,200,50) (renderer.py:4596-4603)

Line heights (scaled px): guide === 30 / bullet 20 / blank 10 / colon-header 25 / default 18; invention header 30 / discipline 25 / entry 22 / @lines 16 / blank 8; skills+titles entry block 16+16+20 with 52 skip-height; stats row 18 (renderer.py:4294-4311, renderer.py:4526-4566, renderer.py:4616-4666, renderer.py:4736-4788, renderer.py:4828-4919)

Icon sizes: skills/titles 24x24 (icon shifts text indent 10->40), active quest 20x20, completed quest 16x16 at alpha 128 (renderer.py:4341-4344, renderer.py:4472-4477, renderer.py:4541-4544, renderer.py:4632-4635)
hazards: scroll_offset is SHARED across all 6 tabs and not reset on tab switch (only on open) — switching from a long tab to a short one while scrolled shows an apparently empty tab until the player scrolls up; preserve this bug or document deviation (encyclopedia.py:16-19, game_engine.py:3264-3269)
No max scroll clamp — player can scroll infinitely past content into blank space; render loops merely cull (game_engine.py:1451-1452)

The 12-char '@prefix' slice is positional duck-typing: if the encyclopedia text generator changes padding, the renderer silently truncates content; also '@applies'/'@recipe' prefixes are 8/7 chars + padding — all rely on exactly 12 total (encyclopedia.py:130-191, renderer.py:4866-4908)

Empty-vs-None falsy check: get_invented_recipes_text shows the tutorial empty-state for both None and [] (encyclopedia.py:36); renderer fetches via getattr(character, 'invented_recipes', None) so a missing attribute degrades gracefully (renderer.py:4795)

Tab hit-testing uses window-relative coordinates (mouse minus window origin) because tab rects were built on the panel surface — porting to global coords without converting will break clicks (game_engine.py:3261-3267)

Two copies of the window rect exist: renderer sets self.encyclopedia_window_rect on itself (dead-ish store) AND returns it; engine keeps its own copy used for all hit tests (renderer.py:3692, game_engine.py:8781-8787)

Encyclopedia being open does NOT pause the game or block WASD movement — it only intercepts left-click (inside=tab click, outside=close) and suppresses right-click; enemies keep acting (game_engine.py:1495-1496, game_engine.py:2557-2565)
Unicode glyphs in quest tab (📜, ✓, ○, ✅) and heavy-line ━ headers are font-dependent; Godot font must cover them or substitute (renderer.py:4352, renderer.py:4385, renderer.py:4416, renderer.py:4521)
Guide tab text hardcodes controls/keybinds as prose (e.g. '1-5' skills, 'K' skills menu) — if keybinds change in the port, this static text lies (encyclopedia.py:290-332)
Title chance percentages in the requirement line are a hardcoded display table in the renderer, not read from title data — can drift from actual acquisition logic (renderer.py:4655-4658)

Stats-tab flatten category rule 'key if not category else category' means only the first nesting level becomes the category; deeper keys inherit it, and top-level scalars land in 'General' — sort by (-value, name) interleaves unrelated stats within a category (renderer.py:4697-4712)

Skills tab per-frame calls can_learn_skill for every skill in the database every frame while open — O(n) requirement checks; fine in Python here but worth noting for parity vs optimization (renderer.py:4535)

Quest objective display order-dependence: gather progress uses live inventory minus baseline, so SPENDING materials after gathering reduces shown progress (and completion) — intentional baseline-delta design, must be preserved (renderer.py:4371-4384)
Tab ids are lowercase internal strings ('recipes' tab labeled 'INVENTIONS'; 'adornments' discipline labeled 'ENCHANTING') — keep id/label split (renderer.py:3636, encyclopedia.py:78-79)

ESC-close and click-outside-close paths call encyclopedia.toggle() directly; the click-outside path at game_engine.py:2564 does NOT call _record_menu_close_time, so menu-duration analytics leak an open timer on that path (ESC path at 830-832 and L-toggle path at 896-897 do record) (game_engine.py:2562-2565)
